messages:
kevin-release: Deploy window ready for geo-staged rollout. Target plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary US 10% (2h), ramp EU to 25% (1.5h) after warmup, APAC overnight full. Need quick capacity thumbs-up and any pin/rollback constraints. Release notes: model-infer v4.3.0 (int8 opt). @jordan-sre @anya-ml :eyes:

deploy-bot: starting canary job: job_id=canary-1723418100
```
[deploy-bot] booting canary fleet US (us-central1)
[deploy-bot] target=10% instances=6
[deploy-bot] health checks: passing
[deploy-bot] smoke test: running (30m window)
```

jordan-sre: Quick capacity check: US (us-central): spare GPUs 48/60 -> headroom ~30% (safe to do 10% canary + 20% cushion). EU (fra): spare GPUs 18/40 -> headroom ~45% but thermal threshold near midday, recommend slow ramp and warm pool first (suggest keep EU at 15% until warm pool + ~10 GPUs ready). APAC (sg): spare GPUs 6/16 -> low, please schedule warmup before APAC ramp. Also propose regional rate caps: US 200r/s, EU 100r/s, APAC 80r/s for initial ramp.

anya-ml: Note on model quality: v4.3.0 int8 shows ~2-3% regression on long-context tests (>2k tokens) vs v4.2.7 fp16. For user-facing critical routes we should either pin to v4.2.7 or route enterprise traffic to fallback. Suggest: pin enterprise routes to v4.2.7 during EU ramp; monitor perplexity and exact-match evals.

laura-eng: Agree with pin idea. I'll prepare a route pin: `route:redwood-gen => v4.2.7` for enterprise orgs in EU during the ramp. Rollback thresholds proposed: P50 latency > 220ms sustained for 5m OR error rate increase +1% absolute over baseline => immediate rollback.

maria-pm: Change window confirmed 21:00-02:00 UTC. PMs and CS notified about enterprise pin and potential short regression. Release notes ready; blurb: "v4.3.0 brings 30% token throughput improvement (int8) — minor quality delta on very long contexts, fallback pinned for enterprise during staged rollout."

sanjeev-eng: Running smoke tests now against canary: 
```
smoke-run: model v4.3.0 @ US-canary
qps: 50
latency p50: 180ms p95: 320ms
5xx: 0
eval-smoke-suite: PASS (sanity prompts)
```

opsbot: Canaries stable for 30m, no 5xx spikes, error rate within baseline. Marking US canary green. :white_check_mark:

kevin-release: Good. Proceed to EU warmup at +40m. I'll pin enterprise routes to v4.2.7 for EU as discussed. If EU warmup doesn't reach target headroom (reserve >= 60% of intended warm pool) within 45m we abort EU ramp and hold US canary at 10% or rollback (decision at ops lead). @deploy-bot please schedule EU warmup.

deploy-bot: Scheduling warmup: region=eu-west1 target_warm=20% timeout=30m model=v4.3.0
Command: ```deploy schedule --region eu-west1 --warm 20 --timeout 30m --model v4.3.0```

jordan-sre: I'll watch thermal/cooling metrics and GPU temps. Adding temporary rate-limit rule for EU: `route:redwood-gen => 100r/s eu` until warm pool stabilizes. Tagging infra-oncall if heatmap > 70% CPU for > 10m.

kevin-release: Thanks — keep status updates short in thread. If any rollback triggers hit, call it here and we'll flip enterprise pin back and roll back canary.
